name: Gumon Yuugi ~Otome-tachi e no Gumon Seme~
original_name: Guも～ん遊戯 ～乙女たちへの愚問責め～
source:
Main heroine is a school psychological consultant. She needs to diagnose correctly psychological problem of six girls and help them overcome those problems.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一名学校心理咨询师。她需要正确诊断六名女孩的心理问题，并帮助她们克服这些问题。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
